{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Drop rows where customer_age is -1 (missing sentinel)
dropped_age = sales[sales['customer_age'] != -1]

# Compute mean age of valid entries
mean_age = dropped_age['customer_age'].mean()

print(f"Mean age (excluding -1 sentinel): {mean_age}")

# Confirm the count of valid ages
valid_count = len(dropped_age)
print(f"Valid age entries: {valid_count} out of {len(sales)} total")"}
